d: Gukesh and Sindarov have very different stories coming into the 2026 World Chess Championship. One is the reigning world champion looking to defend his crown, while the other is a young challenger who has enjoyed a remarkable run through the Candidates Tournament and the World Cup. Their first encounter brought a tense contest, a battle of preparation and a hard-fought draw. With the scores level at half a point apiece, the question now is whether Gukesh can turn the tables when he gets the White pieces. Rupha Ramani looks at what Game 1 tells us about the title race and the challenges…
